characters.name: Tamara
characters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / clothing-only Christmas costume edit of an existing 16-bit fighting-game sprite. IMAGE 1 is the ONLY character identity, pose, scale and layout authority. Preserve that exact recognizable human face, hair, facial hair, skin, age, body build, proportions, hands, clenched fists, anatomy, right-facing side-view guard stance and both foot positions. IMAGE 2 is an outfit-and-palette reference ONLY: do NOT copy its person's face, physique, hair or pose. Preserve the original coarse 16-bit arcade pixel-art treatment, crisp square pixel clusters, stair-step dark outlines and restrained hard-edged shading. No extra fine detail, no smooth painting, no photorealistic rendering, no blur. Full body, exactly one character on genuine transparent alpha background. No floor or cast shadow, no background/checkerboard printed into image, no text, no extra props or people. Keep the base image's generous square margins and relative character size; do not zoom in. Aim for a square 512x512 sprite with the feet still at y432, head at the same height and same body silhouette as the source. Entire head, fists and footwear must remain uncropped. Change clothing only as follows: Tamara is a CHRISTMAS ELF. Replace her long dark grey cardigan and black outfit with a long forest-green elf tunic/jacket with burgundy collar, cuffs and pointed hem, understated gold edging and gold buttons, dark brown belt with small gold buckle, burgundy full-length trousers and dark brown ankle boots with small buckles. Keep the overall long-tunic silhouette compatible with her source outfit and clearly separate both legs in the same guard stance. Preserve her long wavy brown/honey-highlighted hair, dark eyeglasses, exact adult female face, small silver pendant and bare human hands. No hat obscuring her hair, no pointed fantasy ears, no transformation into another person. Outfit style consistent with image 2, identity and pose exclusively from image 1.
